name: Teghia Enterprise — Interior, Civil Construction & Renovation Services
description:
# About Our Founder — Jalaluddin Ansari

## 45+ Years of Experience. A Commitment to Quality.

**Jalaluddin Ansari | Founder, Teghia Enterprise — Interior, Civil Construction & Renovation Services**

Jalaluddin Ansari brings over **45 years of experience in civil construction, building maintenance, and renovation** to Teghia Enterprise. His extensive practical knowledge, dedication, and craftsmanship guide the company's approach to residential and commercial projects.

A significant milestone in his professional journey is his **30 years of experience working as a civil contractor for Canara Bank**. This long-standing professional association has provided extensive exposure to civil works, building maintenance, repairs, renovations, and property upkeep.

Under his leadership, Teghia Enterprise is committed to delivering quality-focused workmanship, practical building solutions, transparent communication, and budget-conscious project execution.

### Our Services

Teghia Enterprise offers a comprehensive range of interior and civil work services, including:

- Interior design, space planning, and complete home renovation.
- Modular kitchens, wardrobes, custom furniture, and storage solutions.
- Bathroom renovation, tiling, plumbing, sanitaryware, and waterproofing.
- Civil construction, masonry, brickwork, plastering, and structural repairs.
- Flooring, ceramic and vitrified tiles, marble, granite, and stonework.
- Interior and exterior painting, false ceilings, POP, and lighting coordination.
- Electrical work, plumbing, drainage, and building maintenance.
- Terrace waterproofing, leakage treatment, roofing, and protective sheds.
- Doors, windows, glass partitions, balcony grills, and metal fabrication.
- Commercial interior fit-outs, office renovations, and exterior finishing.

From individual repair jobs to complete turnkey renovation projects, our focus is on understanding customer requirements, preparing transparent quotations, selecting suitable materials, and completing work according to the agreed scope and schedule.

### Our Service Areas

Teghia Enterprise serves customers across **Navi Mumbai, Mumbai, Thane, Raigad, Pune, and Palghar**, subject to project requirements and site assessment.

### Our Philosophy

We believe that quality workmanship, honest communication, reliability, and customer satisfaction are the foundations of lasting business relationships.

**Our Promise: Quality Service On Time, Within Budget.**

With more than 45 years of professional experience guiding our approach, Jalaluddin Ansari continues to emphasize practical expertise, dependable service, and lasting customer relationships.

**Teghia Enterprise — Building Trust Through Experience.**
